title: Quantum Compression for Distributed Entanglement
summary: We study compression strategies for multipartite entanglement distribution under uncertainty in the partitioning of the quantum state. When the partition is not known at the time of state preparation, we show that a joint design of the resource state and a family of compression schemes can increase the entanglement across partitions under a fixed transmission budget. We formulate this as a source coding problem and derive non-asymptotic upper and lower bounds on the achievable average entanglement subject to an average coding rate.
